name: Stocking Up
plugin: ccBGSSSE001-Fish.esm (last edited by Synthesis - Gameplay Overwrite.esp)
canDoWhy: A repeatable fishing bounty that Swims-In-Deep-Water hands you at the Riften Fishery; an innkeeper somewhere wants fresh fish.

starts.where: inside the Riften Fishery on the Riften docks (he works there from early morning into the evening; nights at Haelga's Bunkhouse)
starts.how: He gives you a fishing bounty letter. Read it to learn which innkeeper wants fish and which kind.

firstStep: Read the bounty letter Swims-In-Deep-Water gave you

takesYou.place: an inn in a town picked when the bounty is given
takesYou.why: bring the fish to the innkeeper

objectives: Read the bounty letter (one of: Supply of Brook Bass, Supply of Salmon, Supply of Catfish, Supply of Arctic Grayling)
Obtain the number of fish the bounty asks for: brook bass, salmon, catfish or arctic grayling
Speak to the innkeeper
The bounty fails if the innkeeper dies before you hand in the fish

rewards.when: when you hand the fish to the innkeeper

people.name: Swims-In-Deep-Water
people.role: gives the bounty letter, Riften Fishery

people.name: the innkeeper (picked by the bounty)
people.role: wants the fish and pays you

unsure.why: The records don't show what Swims-In-Deep-Water needs from you before he hands out bounties; it is likely after you have introduced yourself to him in Angler Acquaintances, but that link isn't in these files.
The town, innkeeper and number of fish are chosen when the bounty is given; the records only hold the slots, not the list of possible inns.
The amount of gold is set by the quest's script and isn't in these files.

name: Hunter Marks Animal Den
plugin: Hunters Mark Animal Den on Map.esp (no other plugin edits it)
canDoWhy: A hunter (or a wandering fisherman) you meet can point you to an animal den in the hold you're in, marked on your map.

starts.where: out in the wild, in whichever hold you are travelling through (Solstheim too)
starts.how: Talk to them; they tell you about an animal den nearby and it goes on your map.

firstStep: Hunt down animals at the den the hunter marked

takesYou.place: an animal den picked from the hold you are in
takesYou.hold: varies (any of the nine holds or Solstheim)
takesYou.why: kill the animals there, including the den's leader

objectives: Hunt down animals at the marked den

rewards.when: when the den is dealt with

people.name: a hunter
people.role: gives the den's location; any hunter or trapper, or the travelling fisherman

unsure.why: The records show the quest is set up each time you move to a new place in a hold, and that the opening talk needs the speaker to be a hunter or the fisherman; the line itself isn't in these files.
The gold is paid by the quest's script; the amount, and whether you must go back to the hunter to get it, aren't in these files.
A setting of 10 belongs to this quest's opening; it may be a chance or a cooldown, not a level. What it controls isn't in these files.
